hadiths.text_english:
The following hadith is from the Musnad al-Imam Zayd ibn Ali:

Zayd ibn Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) said: "Allah has forbidden for a man to marry his mother, paternal aunt, maternal aunt, grandmother, step-mother, and sister. And as for the prohibition on marrying seven women, it is: The daughter of one's father, the daughter of one's son, the wife of one's brother, the wife of one's uncle, the wife of one's nephew, a woman who has been nursed by one's mother, a woman who has been nursed by one's milk-sister, and a woman with whom one has had sexual intercourse. And as for the seven women in the prohibition on marrying them, it is: The wife of one's father, the wife of one's son, the daughter of one's brother, the daughter of one's uncle, the daughter of one's nephew, a woman who has been nursed by one's mother and then married to one's son, and a woman who has not been nursed by one's mother but is the daughter of one's wife. And as for the child born from a marriage between two milk-sisters, it is permissible."

hadiths.text_english: Zubayr ibn Ali said: Adi said: His grandfather said: 'Ali may Allah be pleased with him said: The Messenger of God peace be upon him said: "Do not marry a woman to her aunt, nor to her sister-in-law. Nor to the daughter of an unmarriageable relative, nor to the daughter of a breast-feeding mother. Do not marry the elder to the younger."

hadiths.text_english: It has been narrated from Zayd that his father said: His grandfather, Ali ibn Abi Talib, may Allah be pleased with him, disliked it when a man had two slave girls as companions.

hadiths.text_arabic: حدثني زَيْدُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَدِيَّةَ عَنْ جَدِّهِ عَن طَلَلَةَ رضي الله عنه قال: إنَّ تِتَّةَ رَوْجُ أُمَّةٌ على الدَّرَّةِ وودُّ أَدْرَةٌ على الأمة، ولا زواج الرجل الممادم أو عودية، ولا النصرانية على الم... أراد بالصغرى في درج التسب لا في السن. وي أغالي اللداء أحمه دن كشن وعدي الله عدوي لوو إلى قلق رضي الله عنه قال: إذا زوج رجل أمة على حرة ففرق مدر المؤمذددن رضم الله عئه. ديتهما وقال: دحل لك أن تترى م أهة دي حرث. ورواه الأمير سلام بن إبراهيم بن تاج الدين في تكملة للشامء. أما سد ملل الإمام ردك ب م1 مي المسلمة على المهودية والنصرانية ولاعدرة دومات دن القسم وللآمة بوم.

hadiths.text_english:
Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) who said:

A free man may not marry a slave woman if he has a free wife, nor may a free woman marry a slave man, nor may a Muslim woman marry a Jewish or Christian man.

(He meant by "younger" in terms of lineage, not age.)

(2) And my father, may Allah be pleased with him, narrated to me from Ahmad ibn Kathir, from Abdullah ibn Wahb, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) who said: A man married a slave woman while he had a free wife, so the Commander of the Faithful (may Allah be pleased with him) separated them and said: "It is not permissible for you to marry a slave woman while you have a free wife."

(3) And the Imam Zayd ibn Ali (peace be upon him) said: A Muslim woman may not marry a Jewish or Christian man. And a free woman has two days and two nights of division (of time with her husband), and a slave woman has one day and one night.

hadiths.text_arabic: حدثنا زيك بن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي رضي الله عنهما قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: "كما عيش تزوج دغير إذل موالية فهو زان".

hadiths.text_english: 2 Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali, may Allah be pleased with them, said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "Any woman who marries without the permission of her guardian, then her marriage is invalid."

hadiths.text_arabic: (حدثي) زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي رضي الله عنه أن رجلاً أتاه فقال: إن عبدي تزوج بغير إذني، فقال له علي رضي الله عنه: فرق دينهما. فقال السيد لعيده: طاقها دا عدو الله، فقال علي رضي الله عنه للسيد: قد أجزت النكاح؛ فإن شئت أيها العبد فطلق، وإن شئت فأمسك. حدثي زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي رضي الله عنه أن رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: زواج صفية وجعل عتقها صداقها. أبو شالد رحمه الله تعالى سأل زيداً بن علي رضي الله عنه عن: العبد هل يجوز له أن يتسرى؟ قال: لا. قال الله عز وجل: والذين هم... لفظه في آمالي أحمد بن عيسى أن رجلاً أتى علياً رضي الله عنه يعيده فقال: يا أمير المؤمنين إن عبدي تزوج بغير إذني، فقال أمير المؤمنين رضي الله عنه لسيده: فرق بينهما. فقال السيد لعبده: يا عدو الله طلق. فقال أمير المؤمنين رضي الله عنه: كيف قلت؟ قال: قلت طلق. فقال أمير المؤمنين لعيده: أما الآن؛ فإن شكت فطلق وإن شكت فأمسك. فقال السيد: يا أمير المؤمنين أمر كان بيدي فجعلته في يد غيري؟ فقال أمير المؤمنين: ذات زيحين قلق... فلا حل فرج إلا بنكاح أو ملك عن. يا الأكفاء عن نكاح الأكفاء؟ فقال: لا يسع بعضهم أكفاء أبعض عربيهم ما لنا، وعليهم دماءهم وأسدتهم وديامسم وأددة وفرائضهم واحدة. أيس أبعضهم على بعضٍ ذلك فضل؟ وقد قال الله جل وعلا: يا تنكهوا أمام كين حي دوموا، وأُذن معي العربي والعجمي أن ونلكتكننا بنات المشركين ويا عربيهم. سأل زيد بن علي عن نكاح العجمي للعربية: حرام هو أم حلال؟ فقال بعضهم: حلال، وقال بعضهم: حرام. فاضا هم: أرأيت إن ولدث ولداً هل ينث لسدية؟ أرأيتم إن طلقها قبل أن يدخل بها لما عليه نصف الصداق؟ أرأيتم إن دخل بها هل يكون طم المسحى أو أهأ؟ أرأيت إن حمل هذا الأعجمي هل يحل طا ثلاث الأزواج الذي قد طلقها ثلاث؟ أرأيتم إن مات قالوا: نعم، قلنا: إذ حلال لأنه لو كان حراماً لم يشبت نسبه وله مال هل تورثوما منه؟ أرأيتم إن رضي بهذا أبوها أو أخوها هل هو جائر وباطل هذا كله جائز وهو نكاح حلال؟ (باب نكاح أهل الكفر).

hadiths.text_english:
Here is the translation of the hadith text:

Zayd ibn Ali reported from his father, who reported from his grandfather, that 'Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) said: A man came to me and said: "My slave has married without my permission." I said to him: "Separate them." The master said to the slave: "May God curse you!" I said to the master: "I have already given permission for the marriage." If you wish, then divorce her. And if you say: 'Do not divorce her,' then do not divorce her."

Zayd ibn Ali reported from his father, who reported from his grandfather, that the Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "Marry Safiyyah and make her ransom her freedom." Abu Shalih said: I asked Zayd ibn 'Ali about the 'Id festival. He said: "No."

Ahmad ibn 'Isa reported in his book of traditions that a man came to 'Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) and said: "O Commander of the Faithful, my slave has married without my permission." The Commander of the Faithful (may Allah be pleased with him) said to the master: "Separate them." The master said to his slave: "May God curse you! Divorce her!" The Commander of the Faithful said: "How did you say that?" He said: "I said divorce her." The Commander of the Faithful said: "Now, if you are unsure, then divorce her. And if you are sure, then do not divorce her."

The master said: "O Commander of the Faithful, an affair was in my hand and I have given it to someone else." The Commander of the Faithful said: "This is a matter that has been entrusted to me, so I have given it to someone else. As for you, O people, do not free your female slaves unless they are married or unless their mothers give them permission. Do not marry except through marriage or by giving her freedom as dowry. And do not take the daughters of the Arabs in marriage except from among those who are capable of marrying."

The Commander of the Faithful said: "Some of you are Arabs and some are non-Arabs, but their blood is one and their faith is one." Some of them are superior to others in lineage, but all of them are equal in faith. And Allah has said: "O people, be mindful of your Lord and fear Him, for the reward of this world and the next is with Him."

The Commander of the Faithful said: "I have been asked about marrying a non-Arab woman to an Arab man. Some say it is permissible, while others say it is forbidden." He said: "If a man has children from his slave-girl, will he be considered as having children from his wife?" If he divorces her before consummating the marriage, does he owe half of the dowry? If he enters into another marriage, will she be considered as married or not?"

The Commander of the Faithful said: "If a non-Arab man marries an Arab woman and then divorces her three times, can he remarry her?" He said: "Yes, it is permissible because if it were forbidden, her lineage would be affected." And does he inherit from her? If her father or brother approves of this marriage, is it valid?"

The Commander of the Faithful said: "All of these are permissible and are considered as a legitimate marriage. As for marrying women from among the People of the Book, it is permissible."

hadiths.text_english: Zayd ibn 'Ali said, "My father narrated to me from his father that 'Ali may Allah be pleased with him said: 'A Muslim man should marry a woman who is a Christian or a Jewess, but he should not marry a Magian or a Mushrikah. And it is disliked for a Muslim to marry the women of Ahl al-Dhimmah and the people of Ta'if.' He also said, 'Let us be the shepherds of those who are astray.'"

Here is the translation of the hadith text:

Zayd ibn Ali narrated from his father, who narrated from his grandfather, who narrated from Ali may Allah be pleased with him, about a Jew. He said: "If a man has married a woman and she becomes pregnant, then if he converts to Islam and she does not convert, the child is considered illegitimate." 

He also mentioned that the verse (2:221) says: "Do not marry Al-Mushrikat until they believe..." This is a prohibition for them. And Allah says in another verse (5:5): "Today all good foods are made lawful for you..."

And he said: "The verse (5:5) was revealed to make permissible for the Muslims what was previously forbidden, and it was also revealed to make permissible for the Jews what was previously forbidden." 

He then mentioned that a Jew had an army of soldiers, and he married his daughter to one of them. The Prophet said: "Today all good foods are made lawful for you..." And this verse (5:5) is a clear statement in this regard.

hadiths.text_english: Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali, may Allah be pleased with them, said: The saying of Allah, the Mighty and Majestic: "And you will never be able to be fair and just between women, even if you desire to." This refers to love, and there is no share for concubines in that.

hadiths.text_english: It has been narrated from Zayd ibn Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, on the authority of his father, on the authority of his grandfather, on the authority of 'Ali, may Allah be pleased with him: The Messenger of Allah used to stay with a woman in her waiting period for seven days when she was a virgin. And if she was not a virgin, he would stay with her for three days.

hadiths.text_arabic: حدثنا علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي رضي الله عنه، أن امرأة خاصمت زوجها في نفقتها فقضى لها بنصف صاع من بر لي كل يوم. وجد عن زيد بن علي رضي الله عنه أنه قال: لا يتزوج الرجل المسلم اليهودية والنصرانية على المسلمة، ويتزوج المسلمة على اليهودية والنصرانية. (هـ من المنهاج الجلي بلفظه عي). وذو أمالي أحمد ابن عيسى رضي الله عنه ما لفظه أحمد بن عيسى عن حسين بن علوان عن أبي خالد عن زيد بن علي رضي الله عنه قال: إذا أسلمت المرأة دعت الرجل إلى الإسلام؛ فإن أسلم أقامت أن شاءت على نكاحها، وإن لم تشأ كانت أملكه لنفسها. وإذا أسلم الرجل من أهل الكتاب دعا امرأته إلى الإسلام؛ فإن أجابته، وإلا أقام عليها. (هـ أيحف ياب الاحصان)

hadiths.matn_ar: قال: اذا أسلمت المراة دعت الرجل الى الاسلام ؛ فان اسلم أقامت أن شاءت على نكاحها » وان لم تشاء كانت أملك لنفسها , واذا أسلم الرجل من أهل الكتاب دعى امراته الى الاسلام ‏ فان أجابته , والا أقام عليها | ه ٠‏ أيحف ياب الاحصان
hadiths.text_english:
2 Zayd ibn Ali narrated from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, that a woman disputed with her husband concerning her maintenance, so he ruled for her half a sa' of wheat each day.

From Zayd ibn Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, he said: A Muslim man should not marry a Jewish or Christian woman in addition to a Muslim woman, but he may marry a Muslim woman in addition to a Jewish or Christian woman.

This is from Al-Minhaj Al-Jali with its wording. And in the dictations of Ahmad ibn Isa, may Allah be pleased with him, what Ahmad ibn Isa narrated from Husayn ibn Ulwan from Abu Khalid from Zayd ibn Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, he said: If a woman embraces Islam, she invites the man to Islam. If he embraces Islam, she may remain in her marriage if she wishes. If she does not wish, she has more right over herself. If a man from the People of the Book embraces Islam, he invites his wife to Islam. If she responds, [well and good], otherwise he remains married to her.

Here is the translation of the hadith text:

It was narrated from Ayyub from Zayd ibn Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, who said: "There is no fortress for the Muslim in Judaism nor in Nazarene-ism nor in polytheism nor in paganism."

hadiths.text_arabic: حدثني زَيْدُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَدْهِ عَنْ هَمَّةَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ قَالَ دِرْهَمُ النِّكَاحِ مِنْ أَرْبَعَةِ أَشْعَاشٍ مِنَ الْحِذَامِ وَالْحَنُونِ وَالْبَرْصِ وَالْفُقِّ.

hadiths.text_english: Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) who said: "Flee from marriage with four types of women: the leper, the insane, the one afflicted with vitiligo, and the one with a vaginal fistula."

hadiths.text_arabic: حدثني زيد بن علي عن أنيه عن مجده عن علي رضي الله عنهما أن رجلاً تزوج امرأة... وفي آمالي الإمام أحمد بن عيسى بسنده إلى الإمام زيد أنه قال: لا حدّ للرجل بالدوونة، ولا التصير، إنيةان، والابالامة مذ قفن واحعيق بواحدة منهن وقع عليه الحد ولم يقع عليه الرجم. أما الجذام كغراب علة تحدث من انتشار السوداء في البدن كله فيفسد مزاج الأعضاء وهياتها وريما انتهى إلى أكل الأعضاء وسقوطها. فرع قلت: وكذا ترد بالعفل؛ والقرن تفريعاً على الرتق، والوجه قسي ذلك أنه عيب يمتنع من استيفاع الوطء فكان له رده ضه كالرتق. (والعفل) شيع يخرج من فرج المرأة كالادرة، وقيل: هي شيع مدون يخرج في الفرج ولا يكون في الابكار، وقيل: هي ورم في اسكتى المرأة وعدى نا أفروهيا. حض لينهد عن الكل. عذيوط تصحيحه في ديوان الأدب على وزن فعلول يكسر الفاء وفتح اللام قال الشاعر: اق يليه يقانوط ليقو.

hadiths.text_english:
Zayd ibn Ali narrated from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) that a man married a woman and found her to be 'afala. So he disliked her, and they were separated.

(1) In the Amali of Imam Ahmad ibn Isa, with his chain of narration to Imam Zayd, he said: "A man should not be subjected to the hadd punishment for fornication or adultery unless he has intercourse with one of them. If he has intercourse with one of them, the hadd punishment is applied to him, but not stoning."

(2) Leprosy (al-judham), like a raven, is an illness that arises from the spread of black bile throughout the entire body, corrupting the temperament of the organs and their structure. It may even lead to the eating away and falling off of limbs.

(3) A branch: I say: And similarly, she is returned due to 'afal and qarn, as a sub-issue of ratq. The reason for this is that it is a defect that prevents the consummation of intercourse, so he has the right to return her, just like ratq. ('Afal) is something that comes out of a woman's private parts, like al-adra. It is also said that it is a foul-smelling thing that comes out in the private parts. It does not occur in virgins. It is also said that it is a swelling in the woman's buttocks, and it is also said that it is a swelling in the woman's labia.

(4) 'Adhyut: Its correction in Diwan al-Adab is on the pattern of fa'lul, with a kasra on the fa and a fatha on the lam. The poet said: "He is like an 'adhyut, who kills from the Arabs if he is old."

I asked Zayd (may Allah be pleased with him) about its interpretation. He said: It is when a man marries off his daughter to another man on the condition that the other man marries off his daughter to him, and there is no dowry for either of them.

hadiths.text_english: 2 Zayd ibn Ali reported from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) who said: "Whoever has intercourse with a woman who is less than twenty years old is a guarantor."

hadiths.text_arabic: (حدثني) زيد بن علي عن أبيه، عن جهةٍ عن كل راصي إليه، أن رجلًا تزوج امرأة فرفت إليها أنختها لوعو عا فضي إلى (رضي الله عنه)، أن للثانية مهرها بأوطأ، ولا يقرب الأولى حتى تنقضي عدة الأخرى. [ويُعرّف] العذيوط: الذي إذا جامع تغوط في حال جماعة، وإذا كانت المرأة بهذه المثانة فهي عذيوطة. قلت: وكذا إذا وجدته بالوطء عند الجماع، والوجه الخبر: لأن النفس تنضطر ممن كانت هذه حالته، فلم يكن فرق بين الوجهين. قلت: وكذا إذا كان يضرط عند الجماع ضرطاً خارقاً للعادة؛ فإنه كالغائط والبوط لما قدمنا في المسألة والفرع متها. أما إذا كانت علامة فلا فسخ، والوجه: الإجماع أي تستبري بحيضها لعلم خلو الهم بباب الرضاع.

hadiths.text_english:
Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) regarding a man who married a woman, and then it was revealed to him that she was his sister through suckling. Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) ruled that the second woman should receive her dowry due to the intercourse, and he should not approach the first woman until the waiting period (iddah) of the other woman has ended.

(The term) al-ʿudhyūṭ: is one who, when he has intercourse, defecates during the act of intercourse. If the woman is in this state, she is an ʿudhyūṭah. I say: And similarly, if she finds him urinating during intercourse. The reason for this ruling is that the soul is repulsed by one whose condition is like this. So there is no difference between the two situations. I say: And similarly, if he farts during intercourse with an unusual fart, then it is like defecation and urination, as we have presented in the issue and its branch.

(1) However, if she was aware, there is no annulment. The reason for this is consensus, meaning she should observe a waiting period (istibra’) with her menstruation to ascertain the emptiness of the womb.

(Chapter on Suckling) (1)

hadiths.text_english: Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) who said: I said, "O Messenger of Allah, we long for the women of Quraysh, but we do not desire our own women." He said, "Do you have anything?" I said, "The daughter of my paternal uncle Hamza." He said, "She is my niece through suckling, O Ali. Do you not know that Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, has legislated through suckling what He has forbidden through lineage?"

hadiths.text_arabic: (حدثي) زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي رضي الله عنهم في قول الله جل إسمه: والوالدات يرضعن أولادهن حولين كاملين ان أراد أن يتم الرضاعة قال: الرضاع سنتان فكان من رضاع في المولين حزم وما كان بعد الحولين فلا يرمء. قال الله تعالى: وحمله وفصاله ثلاثون شهراً فالحمل ستة أشهر والرضاع (5) والوجه في ذلك ما رويناه عنه عن أمير المؤمنين رضي الله عنه أن عمر أتي بامرأة قد حملت فوضعت حملها لستة أشهر فهم بها عمر ثم قال: ادعوا لي عليا فقال: ما ترى في هذه المرأة؟ قال رضي الله فخة: نوما أنها فاخيرة. قال هلي إن لباقي كتابا الله هدر مخ قرا وحمله وقفصاله ثلاثون شهراً فحمله ستة أشهر؛ وقصاله أريع وعشرون شهراً، فكان عمر لم يقراها. هاج ٥م

hadiths.matn_ar: قال : ( رضى الله عنه ) قد حرمت عايه ع وءايه نصف 27 صداق الصبية » ويرجع على أمه إن كانت قد تعمدت الفساد
hadiths.text_english:
Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them all), regarding the saying of Allah, glorified be His Name: "And mothers shall suckle their children for two full years, for those who wish to complete the suckling." He said: "Suckling is two years." So, whatever suckling occurs within the two years is forbidden (in marriage). And whatever occurs after the two years is not forbidden. Allah Almighty said: "And his gestation and weaning are thirty months." So, gestation is six months, and suckling is twenty-four months. The evidence for this is what we have narrated from him, from the Commander of the Believers (may Allah be pleased with him), that Umar was brought a woman who had conceived and delivered her child at six months. Umar intended to punish her, then he said: "Call Ali for me." He said: "What do you think of this woman?" Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) said: "She is not to be punished. Has Allah's Book been neglected? He recited: 'And his gestation and weaning are thirty months.' So, his gestation is six months, and his weaning is twenty-four months." It was as if Umar had not read it.

I asked Zayd ibn Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) about one suckling and two sucklings. He said: "It is forbidden." I asked him (may Allah be pleased with him) about the milk of the male. He said: "It is forbidden." I asked him (may Allah be pleased with him) about a man who married a young girl, and his mother suckled her. He (may Allah be pleased with him) said: "She is forbidden to him, and he owes her half of the girl's dowry. He can seek recourse from his mother if she intentionally caused corruption."

hadiths.text_arabic: وسألته رضي الله عنه عن الرجل الذي يتزوج امرأة، فقال: قد حُرّمت عليه. ثم قال (رضي الله عنه): قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم: من نظر إلى فرج امرأة وابنتها ألم يحدَّ ريح الحنة؟ قال: فإن قَبَّلها لشهوة أو لمسها لشهوة؟ قال: لا يحرم إلا الغشيان. وسألته رضي الله عنه عن مسألة تتعلق بالصداق، ووجه القول أنه يلزم نصف الصداق إذا فسخ النكاح قبل الدخول من جهتها، فوجب عليه النصف كما لو طلقها. والوجه في الرجوع على أمه أن الالتزام له لما لزمه جاء من جهتها فلزمها ما وجب عليه دليله إذا أفسد على امرأته حجها؛ ودليله أن يشهد شاهدان بما وجب الحد، فإن انكشف أنهما شهدا باطلاً فإن الذي يجب للحدود إنما هو عليهما إذ هما السبب. ووجه آخر روينا عن أمير المؤمنين رضي الله عنه من غير طريق الإمام رضي الله عنه أنه رُفع إليه رجل له ابنة من امرأة عربية وأخرى من عجمية، فزوّج التي هي من العربية من رجل وأدخل عليه ابنته العجمية فقضى عليه رضي الله عنه للتي دخلت عليه بالمهر وقضى للزوج على أبيها لتعريره وقضى للزوج بزوجته. ووجه هذه المسألة ما أوضحه رضي الله عنه، وروينا عن النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم من غير طريق الإمام أنه قال: «لا ينظر الله عن وجل إلى رجل نظر إلى فرج امرأة وابنتها». وليس لقائل أن يقول: قد تقدم الخبر عن النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم. (ويُذكر أيضاً) عن الرجل الذي يتزوج امرأة، فقال: لا بأس به.
hadiths.sanad: وسألته رضى الله عنه عن الرجل دزي بأم إمرأته © قأل : قد حرمت عليه » تم قال ( رضي الله عنه ) : قال رسول الله م : د من نظر إلى فرج امرأة وابنتها ألم يحد ريح الحنة ») قات : فإن قباها لشهوة + أو لمسها لشهوة ؟ قال : لا يحرم إلا الغشيان (') وسألته رضي )١(‏ والوجه قي أنه يلزم نصف الصداق : أن النكاح منفسخ قبل الدخول لا فه من جهتها » فوجب عليه النصف » كما لى طلقها . والوجه في الرجوع على آمه أن الالزام له لما لزمه جاء من جهتها فلزمها ما وجب عليه دليله اذا أفسد على امرأته حجها ؛ ودليله أذن! شهد شاهدان يما دوجب الحد ,2 قانفذه الحاكم ٠‏ كم انكشف انهما شهدا باطلا فان الذي يجب للحدود انما هى عليهما اذ هما السبب ٠‏ ووجه آخر روينا عن أمير المؤمنين رضي الله عنه من غير طريق الامام رضي الله عذه أنه رفع اليه رجل له ابنة من امرأة عربية » وآخرى من عجمية » فزوج التي هي من العربية من رجل ٠‏ وأدخل عليه ابنته العجمية فقضى عليه رضي الله عنه للتي دخلت عليه بالمهر » وقضى للزوج على أبيها لتعريره » وقضى للزوج بزوجته ١‏ هاج ٠‏ ووجه هذه المسألة ما أوضحه رضي الله عنه وروينا عن النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم من غير طريق الامام أنه قال : « لا ينظر الله عن وجل الى رجل نظر الى فرج آمراة وابنتها » 2 وليس لقائل أن يقول : قد تقدم الخبر عن النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم , أثه لا يحرم الحراء هه 3 0 0 0 5 ع ألله عنئه عن : الرجل يزي بأمرأةء 3 يتزوجها ؟
hadiths.matn_ar: قال : لا بأس به .
hadiths.text_english:
The Prophet (peace be upon him) was asked about a man who had sexual relations with his mother-in-law. He said: "It has been forbidden to him." The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "Is he not looking at the private part of his wife and daughter? Does he not smell the scent of musk?" He said: "He is only prohibited from fornication."

He was asked, may Allah be pleased with him, about a man who had to pay half of the dowry because he had nullified the marriage before consummation. He said: "It is obligatory on him." Another aspect regarding this matter is that if he returns to his wife, it is obligatory for her to give him what was obligatory for him, as a proof is that if she invalidates his hajj, and the proof is that two witnesses testify to what is obligatory for the penalty. If they are proven to be false witnesses, then the penalty is only on them because they are the cause.

Another aspect regarding this matter is that we have narrated from Amir al-Mu'minin, may Allah be pleased with him, through a different chain of narration than Imam Zayd ibn Ali, may Allah be pleased with him. A man came to him with his daughter from an Arab woman and another from a non-Arab woman. He married the Arab woman and took in the non-Arab daughter. Amir al-Mu'minin, may Allah be pleased with him, ruled that the dowry was obligatory on the one who entered upon her, and he ruled that the husband should pay for his wife's maintenance, and he ruled that the husband should give to his wife what was obligatory.

The aspect of this matter that has been clarified is that we have narrated from the Prophet (peace be upon him) through a different chain of narration than Imam Zayd ibn Ali, may Allah be pleased with him. He said: "Allah does not look at a man who looks at the private part of a woman and her daughter." It is not for anyone to say that this hadith has been narrated before regarding the Prophet (peace be upon him) saying: "It is forbidden for a man to have sexual relations with his mother-in-law."

He was asked, may Allah be pleased with him, about a man who marries a woman and then has sexual relations with her sister. He said: "There is no harm in that."

hadiths.text_arabic: وسألته (رضى الله عنه) عن: الرجل يتزوج المرأة على خادم؟ قال: لا. وسأله رضي الله عنه عن: الرجلين يدعيان امرأة، كل واحد منهما معه شاهدان يشهدان أنها امرأته؟ قال: الشهادة باطلة. قلت: فإن وقتت إحدى الشهادتين وقت الأخرى قبل الشهادة الأخرى؟ قال: هو أحق بها. وسأله (رضى الله عنه) عن: الرجل وامرأته، أُعطيا المهر؟ قال: ها مهر مثلها من قومها. ... ويريد رضي الله عنه هذه الرواية: من نظر إلى فوج امرأة وابنتها فإن هذا الضبر خاص؛ وقوله صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم: «لا يحرم الحرام الحلال» ففيجون له أن ينكح أخته من الولد يعدى المخلوقة من ماء أبيه من الزنا، وكذلك المرأة المخلوقة من ماء أبه من الزنا لا تكون عمة له فيحل نكاحها، وكذلك المرأة المخلوقة من ماء جده أي أمه من الزنا يحل له نكاحها ولا تكون خالة له عملاً بالحديث «لا يحرم الحرام الحلال». وتفريعا على قوله رضي الله عنه في مسألة الكفاءة: أرايتم أن ولدت (أي الحرة العربية) للعجمي ولدًا هل يثبت نسبه؟ قالوا: نعم. قلنا: هي إذا حلال، لأنه إذا كان حراماً لم يثبت نسبه. وإذا كان كلاهما... فإذا حلفت من امرأة أن تذكره لهذا الحموم وهي الحرام لا يحرم الحلال؛ فقد خُصَّت المخلوقة من ماء الرجل، فمن نظر إلى قرج امرأة وابنتها لم يجد رائحة الجنة. والمراد بقومها: من كان من قبل أبيها. والوجه في ذلك أثهم القرابة على التحقيق أن هي منهم نسباً وعرقاً. ويوضحه أن علويا لى تكح جارية، فحصل منها ولد، فإن ولدها يكون علوياً إجماعاً؛ فدل أن الاب سه تك.
hadiths.sanad: وسألته ( رضى الله عنه ) عن : الرجل يتزوج المرأة على نخادم ؟ قال : لما خادم وسط » وسأاته رضي الله عنه عن : الرجلين يدعيان امرأة كل واحد منهما معه شاهدان يشهدان أنما امرأته ؟ قال : الشهادة باطلة » قلت ؛ فان وقتت إحدى الشهادتين وقتأ قبل الشهادة الأخرى. ؟ قال : هو أحق بها : وسأاته ( رضي الله عنه » عن : الربجل وامرأته عتلفان ني المهر ؟ قال : ها مهر مثلها من قومها (" , جا 00) العلال م جلك نينا "روووقد هق الف سيلى "اله هليه بزاله وس ذا تقول تق خافن كائراة وابنتها وماء رو اه كن لنى عبني اللةتعلدة وله وسلم يريد رضي الله عنه هذه الرواية » من نظر الى فوج امراة وابنتهاء فان هذا الضبر خاص ؛» وقوله صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم : « لا يحرم الحرام الحلآل عام » فيجون له أن ينكم اخته من الونا يعدى المخلوقة من ماغ أبيه من الزنا وكذلك المرأة المخلوقة من ماء حده من الزنا لا تكون عمة له فيحل نكاحها وكذلك المرأة المجلوقة من ماء جده أي أمه من الزذا 2 يحل له نكاحها ٠‏ ولا تكون خالة له عملا بالحديث لا يحرم الحرام الحلال وتفريعا على قوله رضي الله عنه في مسالة الكفاءة : أرايتم ان ولدت : يعني الحرة العربية أي للعجمي ولدا هل يثيت تسبه؟
hadiths.matn_ar: قالوا : نعم , قلنا : هى اذا حلال , لانه لى كان حراما لم يثبت نسبه , وهد] واف كان كلاهوه ان !اليفك دق الوك لذ كيت تسديا بحل ان حلفت من ماثئة أن يذكحها لهذا الحموم » وهى الحرام لا يحرم الحلال 2 فقد خص البئت المخلوقة من ماء الرجل خسر من نظر الى قرج امراة وابنتها لم يجد رائحة الجنة ٠‏ والمراد بقومها : من كان من قبل أبيها » والوجه في ذلك أثهم القرابة على التحقيق ان هي منهم نسبا وعرقا » يوضحه أن علويا لى تكح جارية, فحصل منها ولد , فان ولدها يكون علويا اجماعا ؛ فدل أن الاب سه تك
hadiths.text_english:
I asked him (may Allah be pleased with him) about a man who marries a woman for a servant. He said: "A servant is a medium [dowry]." And I asked him (may Allah be pleased with him) about two men who claim a woman, each of them having two witnesses testifying that she is his wife. He said: "The testimony is void." I said: "What if one of the testimonies was given at a time before the other testimony?" He said: "He has more right to her." And I asked him (may Allah be pleased with him) about a man and his wife disagreeing about the dowry. He said: "Her dowry is like that of her peers from her people."

And the Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "Whoever looks at the private parts of a woman and her daughter, he will not smell the scent of Paradise." And he (may Allah be pleased with him) meant by this narration: "Whoever looks at the private parts of a woman and her daughter, then this prohibition is specific." And his (peace be upon him) saying: "The unlawful does not prohibit the lawful" is general. So it is permissible for him to marry his sister from adultery, meaning the one created from his father's semen from adultery. And likewise, the woman created from his grandfather's semen from adultery is not his paternal aunt, so it is permissible to marry her. And likewise, the woman created from his grandfather's semen, meaning his mother's, from adultery, it is permissible for him to marry her. And she is not his maternal aunt, acting upon the hadith "The unlawful does not prohibit the lawful." And branching from his (may Allah be pleased with him) saying regarding the issue of compatibility: "Do you not see that if she gave birth," meaning the free Arab woman to the non-Arab, "a child, would his lineage be established?" They said: "Yes." We said: "Then she is lawful, because if it were unlawful, his lineage would not be established." And this is if it was as they said, that the unlawful does not prohibit the lawful. So he specified the girl created from the man's semen. "Whoever looks at the private parts of a woman and her daughter will not smell the scent of Paradise." And what is meant by "her people" is those from her father's side. And the reason for that is that they are the relatives in reality if she is from them by lineage and origin. This is clarified by the fact that if an Alawi marries a slave girl, and a child results from her, then her child is Alawi by consensus. This indicates that the father is the source.

hadiths.text_arabic: (حدثني) زيد بن علي عن أديه عن جده عن علي (رضي الله عنهم): في الرجل يظلم بامرأته ثم يطلقها؟ قال: لها المهر إذا أجاف الباب وأسبل الستر. [ويُذكر أن] المهر للبكر والثيب والحسناء، وأن أحكام المهر تختلف بحسب أحوال المرأة؛ فإذا كانت كغيرها من نسائها، وجب استواء في المهر.
hadiths.sanad: ( حدثني ) زيد بن علي عن أديه عن جده عن علي ( رضي الله عنهم) في الرجل يذلو بامرأته » ثم يطلقها ؟
hadiths.matn_ar: قال : لها المهر إذا أجاف الباب وأسبل الستر . 2077# المراعي ذي القرابة , ولائها شرف دشرفه وتدكى بدئآته ٠‏ فدعكير اهلها منهم أن حسنا فحسين 2٠‏ وان شرها قفشوها ؛ وان ثيبا زان بكرا الا أنهم انا كاذىا يرون المهر واحدا البكر والثيب والحسناء » والشوهاءع بحسب أحوال المراة اعتبر ذلك فيها , والوجه في ذلك انها لا تكون مثل نسائها الا اذا كانت كهم في الصفات التي تى جب استواء في المهر | هاج 5 غم"
hadiths.text_english:
Here is the translation of the hadith text:

Zayd ibn Ali narrated from his father, from his grandfather, from 'Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) about a man who mistreats his wife and then divorces her. He said: "For her is the mahr when he blocks the door and covers her private parts." 2077# The relatives of her family are those who have kinship to her, and their respect towards her is due to her noble lineage and her good beginning. But some people from them say that it's good if she's a Husayn (i.e., a descendant of Husayn ibn 'Ali) and bad if she's a Qasim (i.e., a descendant of Hasan ibn 'Ali). And they say that Thabit is better than Bakr, except that they are lying. They see the mahr as one amount for the virgin, the previously married woman, and the good-looking woman, according to the circumstances of the woman. The matter is that she should not be considered like her fellow women unless she is equal to them in characteristics that make her worthy of equality in the mahr.

hadiths.text_arabic: سألت زيداً بن علي رضي الله عنهما عن: طلاق السنة؟ قال: هو طلاقان؛ طلاق لا يحل له حتى تنكح زوجاً غيره، وإذا لم تنح زوجاً غيره. وطلاق لا يحل له حتى تنكح زوجاً غيره. أما الذي يحل له فهو أن تطهر المرأة من الجماع والحيض، فإذا حيضت ثلاثاً فقد حلّ أُرجَعَ إليها، وهو إذا سجعت... [النص الأصلي يحتاج إلى تدقيق أكبر في هذا الجزء المتقطع] ... فإذا اشتهاط كان خاطباً منها، فإن عاد تزوجها كانت على هؤلاء الأوقات: مد بفاتين. وأما الأولاق أي يه ل ليه حتى تنكم شير ه دوو أن بالةها طهر وأحق برجعة ما لم تقع التليقة الثالثة؛ فإذا طلقها التطليقة الثالثة لم يحل لها حتى تنكح زوجاً غيره. وذُكر أيضاً عن عونا حيضة: أنها إذا وقعت عليها الطليقة الثالثة فقد حُرِّمَت على زوجها، لا تحل له حتى تنكح زوجاً غيره. يدل على ذلك ما قاله في الجامع الكافي ولفظه: قال الحسن ومحمد رضي الله عنهما: إذا أراد الرجل أن يطلق امرأته ثلاثاً للسنة وقد دخل بها فليطلقها عند كل طهر تطليقة، وهي طاهرة من غير جماع؛ فإذا وقعت عليها الطرقة الثالثة فقد حُرِّمَت عليه، ولا تحل له حتى تنكح زوجاً غيره.
hadiths.sanad: سألت زيداً بن علي ( رضي الله عنهما ) عن : طلاق السنة ؟
hadiths.matn_ar: قال : هو طلاقان طلاق نحل له » وإك لم تنح زوجأ غيره » وطلاق لا نحل له حى تنكح زوجآ غيره : أم) الي نحل له . فهو أن عالقوسا واعددة و هن طاهرة من الجماع والخيض 34 9 عمهاها حى ميض ثلاثاً فاذا حاضت ثلاثاً 2) فقد حل أجاها وهو يي در سجعةعأ 6 لم فض حيضة » فاذا اشتسات كان خاطبا من اللدهااس فان عاد ثتزوجها كانت 0-1 على هأ اوقتين مد فباتين 03 وأما اأوالاق أي يه ل ليه حى تنكم 0-6 شير ه ُ دوو أن بالةها 2 53 طهر 0ق © و5و أحق برجعةجا ما لم تقع 1:-إليقة الثالثة : ف'ذا طلقها التطليقة اثاائة لم نحل حبى تنكح زوجآ غير ه 3 ودبكى عليها دن عونا حيضة 69 )١(١‏ دريد رضى الله عنه أنها أذا وقعت عليها التطليقة التالثة 2 فقد حرمت على زوجها لا تحل له حتى تذكح زوجا غيره » يدل على ذلك ما قاله في الجامع الكافي ولفظه : قال الحسن ومحمد رضي الله عنهم : أذا أراد الرجل أن يطلق امرأته ثلاثا للسنة ٠‏ وقد دخل يها فليطلقها عذد كل طهر تطليقة » وهي طاهر من غير جماع » فاذا وقعت عليها التطلرقة الثالثة » فقد حرمت عليه . ولا تحل له حتى تنكم زوجا غيره + ولا تحل 44م
hadiths.text_english:
I asked Zayd ibn Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) about the divorce of the Sunnah. He said: It is two types of divorce: a divorce that permits him to remarry her, even if she does not marry another husband, and a divorce that does not permit him to remarry her until she marries another husband.

As for the divorce that permits him to remarry her, it is when he divorces her while she is in a state of purity from intercourse and menstruation, and he leaves her until she menstruates three times. When she has menstruated three times, her waiting period has ended, and he is more entitled to take her back. If he divorces her during a period of purity, and then she menstruates, and then she becomes pure, he is a suitor among the suitors. If he remarries her, she is with him on two divorces.

As for the divorce that does not permit him to remarry her until she marries another husband, it is when he divorces her during a period of purity, and he is more entitled to take her back as long as the third divorce has not occurred. If he divorces her for the third time, she is not lawful for him until she marries another husband. And the waiting period for her is three menstruations.

(1) Zayd (may Allah be pleased with him) said that if the third divorce occurs, she is forbidden to her husband and is not lawful for him until she marries another husband. This is supported by what he said in Al-Jami' Al-Kafi, and its wording is: Al-Hasan and Muhammad (may Allah be pleased with them) said: If a man wishes to divorce his wife three times according to the Sunnah, and he has consummated the marriage with her, then he should divorce her during each period of purity, while she is pure from intercourse. When the third divorce occurs, she is forbidden to him, and she is not lawful for him until she marries another husband.

hadiths.text_arabic: حدثني زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي (رضي الله عنهم) قال: طلاق الأمة تطايقدان حر كان زوحها أو ثلاث وعدتها حيضتان حراً كان زوجها أم عبداً. قال أبو خالد رحمه الله تعالى:
hadiths.sanad: ( حدثني ) زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي ( رضي الله عنهم )
hadiths.matn_ar: قال : طلاق الأمة تطايقدان حر كان زوحها 5 أو 0 3 وعدتها حيضتان حراً كان زوجها أم عبداً قال أبو خالد رحمه الله تعالى :
hadiths.text_english: It has been narrated to me by Zayd ibn Ali from his father from his grandfather from Ali (may Allah be pleased with him and them) that he said: "The divorce of a woman is valid if she was menstruating at the time of separation, whether her husband was free or slave. If her husband was a slave, then two menstrual cycles must pass before she can remarry." Abu Khalid said:

hadiths.text_arabic: وقال زيد بن علي (رضي الله عنه): وتطاق الصغيرة التي لم تبلغ عند كل شيء، وعدت تلذنة أشون. و اتظطايق: المؤيسة المملاة غنك كل شهر وعد بها ثلاثة يل. وسألته (رضي الله عنه) عن حد اليأس؟ قال: إذا بلغت المرأة خمسين سنة فقد أيست. وسألته رضي الله عنه عن تصدعه الحامل كيف تطاق للسئة؟ قال: عند كل شهر وأجلها أن لحماها حجن للازواج حتى تحيض حيضة أخرى؛ ثم تطهر، قالا: وإن كانت صغيرة أي أيسة. وقد دخل بها قال محمد وكانت حاملا قليطلقها عندي برن كل فون تطليقه أفان رو قفف. الغالقة فكن خرنت عليه فأه تمل جد تنكح زوجاً غيره ولا تحل للأزواج حتى يمضي شهر منذ وقعت التطليقة الغالقة. وأق كاك حاملا شعتى تشع عغليا ولفظة: الرجعة بعد الطلاق ورجعة الكتاب بالفتح والكسر، وبعضهم يقتصر على الفتح في رجعة الطلاق وهي أفصح قال ابن قارس: والرجعة مراجعة الرجل أهله. وقد تكسر ء وقد ملك الرجعة على زوجته وطلاق رجع بالوجهين أيضاً وقلان يؤمن بالرجعة؛ أي بالعود إلى الذيا أ ه مصياح. قال الإمام المهدي رضي الله عنه في المنهاج الجلي ما لمفظه والوجه في ذلك الآنة كال الله تقال دس واوالات الاحمان لعلو أن كمعد حملهن. وروينا عن أمير المؤمنين رضي الله عنه أنه قال: في رجل طلق: امراف، و هئ أهل فقلد، فلن قطااقى كله هال كن حل اليا. ورويذا أن أم كلثوم ابنة عقبة كانت تحت الزبير بن العوام فخرج إلى الصلاة وقد ضصريها الطلق فقالت: طيب نفسي يطلقة. فطلقتها تطلدقة.

hadiths.text_english:
Here is the translation of the hadith text:

Zayd ibn 'Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) said: "The small girl who has not yet reached puberty should perform wudu at every occasion of menstruation. And she should give zakat every month, and it is recommended to give three dates as zakat."

He was asked about the waiting period for divorce, so he said: "When a woman reaches the age of two years, her iddah (waiting period) becomes one year. And if she is pregnant, then her iddah will be until she gives birth and performs wudu."

He was asked about how a pregnant woman should perform ghusl after menstruation, so he said: "She should wait for every month and its complete number of days, and during this time she should not remarry until another menstrual period comes. Then she should perform ghusl."

It is narrated that Muhammad (peace be upon him) was asked about the waiting period for divorce, so he said: "When a woman's husband divorces her, then she should wait for one month and its complete number of days before remarrying another man. And if she becomes pregnant during this time, then her iddah will be until she gives birth."

It is narrated that 'A'ishah (may Allah be pleased with her) said: "The waiting period for divorce is one month, and it is not permissible to remarry until the waiting period has passed."

hadiths.text_arabic: قال: الرجل أحى برجعة امرأته ما لم تغتسل من أخحر حيشة .
hadiths.sanad: ( حدئي اميك الراك اسيك ايه الله عنهم )
hadiths.matn_ar: قال : الرجل أحى برجعة امرأته ما لم تغتسل من أخحر حيشة .
hadiths.text_english: A man asked Imam Zayd ibn Ali, may Allah be pleased with him: "What is the ruling for a woman who has intercourse with her husband while she has not performed wudu?" He replied: "The man must give his wife a second conjugal right only if she performs wudu."

hadiths.text_english: Zayd ibn Ali said, "My father said, 'My grandfather said: The best of the two hajj seasons is Rajab and Sha'ban. If a woman becomes pregnant during these months, she should complete her term. And if she gives birth, then she should wait until the end of her term. If she was pregnant when her husband separated from her, then she should wait until the end of her term. And if she gave birth while her husband was absent from her, then she should wait for half a month.' " May Allah be pleased with him and his family.

hadiths.text_english: Zayd ibn Ali said, "My father said, 'My grandfather said, 'Ala (may Allah be pleased with him) reported that a man divorced his wife who was pregnant. He then married another woman and said: 'Her dowry has been paid in full, even if she gives birth to twins.'"

hadiths.text_arabic: (حدثني) زيد بن علي عن أبي عن جده عن علي (رضي الله عنه) المطلقة واحدة وثنتين وثلاثاً، لا ترجع مقيمته ليله ولا تمأ زا لها، والمتوف عنها زوجها ترجع بالنهار ولا تبيت في غير فرجعت وقد وضعت فأتى النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم فسأله عن ذلك فقال صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم: قد بلغ الكتاب أجله أخطبها إلى نفسها؟ فقال الزبير: خدعتني خدعها الله. ومسألة: لا تحل من أجلها حتى تضع حملها جميعاً، فإن كان معها ولدان فوضعت الأحد، قال أبو الحسن عن أمير المؤمنين رضي الله عنه أنه قال: وإن كان في بطنها ولدان فولدت أحدهما؛ فهو أحق برجعتها ما لم تلد الثاني. و(لا تبيت بيتها ليلاً) ولا تقرس كل واحدة منهما زينة، ولا طيباً إلا أن يكون طلتها طليقة أو طليقتين، فلا يأس أن تدايسب وتزين.

hadiths.text_english:
Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) said:

"A woman divorced once, twice, or thrice, should not leave her house at night, nor should she adorn herself for anyone other than her husband. A woman whose husband has died may go out during the day, but she should not spend the night anywhere other than her home.

A woman who had given birth came to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and asked him about this. The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The decree has reached its term. Should I propose to her myself?' Al-Zubayr said: 'You have deceived me, may Allah deceive him.'

And a ruling: She is not lawful [for marriage to another man] until she has given birth to her entire pregnancy. If she is carrying two children and gives birth to one of them, then her husband has a greater right to take her back, as long as she has not given birth to the second.

From the Commander of the Believers (may Allah be pleased with him) that he said: If she is carrying two children in her womb, and gives birth to one of them, then her husband has a greater right to take her back, as long as she has not given birth to the second.

She should not leave her house at night, and neither of them should adorn herself with ornaments or perfume, unless her divorce is a single or a double divorce. In that case, there is no harm in her adorning herself."

hadiths.text_arabic: (حدثي) زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي -رضي الله عنهم- أن امرأة أتت به فقالت: يا سيدي، أنا منين كاذ لي زوجة فطال صحيتها ولم تلد فطاقةها بلكن ميض فاعتدت بالشهور وكانت ترى أنها من القواعدة فتزوجت فيها فمكثت عنده ثلاثون شهراً فحاضت فأرسل إليها إلى زوجها فسأطهما عن ذلك فأخبرته أن نفسها أعددت بالشهور من غير حيض فقال للأخير: لا شيء بينك وبينها وها المهر بتحولك بها وقال للأول: هي امرأة ناشز ولا تقرأ حتى تقضي عدتها مقامه. هذا قال: قيما أعنة أين قال: بالحيض، قال: فهلكت المرأة قبل أن تنقضي عدتها للزوج الأول ولم يرها الأخير.

hadiths.text_english: Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) reported: A man came to him and said: "O Commander of the Believers, I had a wife, and I lived with her for a long time, but she did not bear children, so I divorced her. She was old and observed her `iddah in months. She thought she was among those who no longer menstruate. So I married her, and she stayed with me for thirty months, then she menstruated." So he sent for her and her husband and asked them about that. She informed him that she had observed her `iddah in months without menstruation. So he said to the latter (the second husband): "There is nothing between you and her, and the dowry is for you because you had intercourse with her." And he said to the first (husband): "She is a woman who has menstruated, and she should not marry until she completes her `iddah." He said: "What is her `iddah?" He said: "By menstruation." He said: "The woman died before her `iddah ended for the first husband, and the latter (second husband) did not inherit from her."

hadiths.text_arabic: 2 حدثي) زيد بن علي عن أديه عن جده عن علي (رضي الله عنهم) قال: الأقراءُ: الحيضُ. قال الإمام المهدي محمد بن المطهر رضي الله عنه في كتابة عقود العقران، بعد أن ذكر ما قيل في القرء اختلافاً ما لفظه: والحق عندي أن القُرء يطلق على الطهر والحضّ، إلا أن المراد به في الشرع الحيضُ. والوجه في ذلك ما روتاه عن النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم أنه قال: «لتي سساأاته وهي مستحاضة دعى الصلاة أيام أقرائك التي كنت تحيضين فيهن». وأيضاً فإن النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم قال: «طلاق الأمة طُلقتان، وعدتها حيضتان»، وهذا نص في موضع النزاع. وكذا ذُكر في الفاسد وقد سأل أن كم تجلس النفساء؟ فقال: ثلاثة أقراء كما تقدم.

2 Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) said: "Al-Aqra' (plural of Qur') are the menses."

The Imam al-Mahdi Muhammad ibn al-Mutahhar (may Allah be pleased with him) said in his book *Uqud al-Aqran*, after mentioning what was said about al-Qur': "...The truth, in my opinion, is that al-Qur' linguistically applies to both menstruation and purity. However, what is intended by it in the Shari'ah is menstruation. The reason for this is what we have narrated from the Prophet (peace be upon him) that he said to a woman who was suffering from irregular bleeding: 'Leave salah during the days of your menses (aqra'ik) in which you used to menstruate.' Also, the Prophet (peace be upon him) said: 'The divorce of a female slave is two divorces, and her waiting period is two menstruations.' This is a clear text in the matter of dispute."

Similarly, his (Ali's) saying in *Al-Fawa'id*, when he was asked: "How long does a woman in postpartum bleeding (nifas) stay?" He replied: "Three menses (quru'), as mentioned previously."

hadiths.text_english: Zayd ibn Ali said, "My father narrated to me from my grandfather from 'Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) that a woman married six men in succession. When she was separated from her last husband and he had fulfilled his obligation of marrying her with her dowry, he made her have multiple marriages from both of them together."

hadiths.text_english: It is narrated from Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, that 'Ali may Allah be pleased with him said: He has made for the divorced woman three things: maintenance and provision.

hadiths.text_english:
Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) said: A man from Quraysh divorced his wife one hundred divorces. This was mentioned to the Prophet (peace be upon him), and he said: "She is irrevocably divorced from him by three, and ninety-seven are a sin on his neck."

Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) cursed the one who makes a woman lawful (for her former husband) and the one for whom she is made lawful.

hadiths.text_arabic: حدّثني زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي رضي الله عنهم: ما نويت فإن قال: نويت واحدة، كانت واحدة بائنًا. وهي فتعتد بعد التفريق باقي عدتها من الأول، ثم تستقبل عدة كاملة من الثاني. وقال الإمام محمد بن المطهر في المنهاج وعنه معنى عن الإمام زيد بن علي رضي الله عنه أنه قال: جاء رجلان من قريش إلى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم فقالا: إن أباكما طلق أمنا مائة تطليقة، فقال رضي الله عنه: أن أباكما عصى ربه فلم يجعل له فرجًا، بانت أمكما من أبيكما بثلاث وسبع وتسعين معصية. ويقال في كنايات الطلاق هي خلية. وإن قال: نويت ثلاثاً، كانت حراماً حبى تنكس زوجاً غيره ولا تحل لذول حتى تدعم بالثاني ويذوق من عسياتها وتذوق عن عسياته. (زيل سن علي عن أبيه عن جده رضي الله عنهم) فإذا الرجل يقول لامرأته: اعتدّي، قال: إن كان لم يدخل بانت، وإذا دخل ما فهي واحدة عليك بالرجعة.
hadiths.sanad: حدتى » زيد بن عل عن أبيه عن جده عن علي ( رضي الله عنهم) ما نويت ٠‏ فإن قال : نويت وأحدة : كانت واحدة بائناً » وهى )١(‏ فتعتد بعد التفريق باقي عدتها من الاول ثم تستقبل عدة كاملة من الثاني أ ه منهاج بالمغفتي.-؟ (؟) قال الامام محمد بن المطهر رضي الله عنه في المنهاج وعنه يعنى عن الامام زيد بن علي رضي الله عنه انه قال : جاء رجلان من قريش الى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم فقالا : ان ابانا طلق امنا مائة تطليقة فقال رضي الله عنه : أن أباكما عصى ربه فلم يجعل له فرجا بانت امكما من أبيكما بثلاث وسبع وتسعون معصية ١‏ ه منهاج ٠‏ ي
hadiths.matn_ar: قال : في كنايات الطلاق هي خلية ! ه مصباح وفيه ما لفظه بته بنا 4ه أمللك بنفسها » وإن قال : نويت ثلاثاً كانت حراماً حبى تنكس زوجاً غيره » ولا تحل لاذول حتى تدعمل 7(" بالثاني ويذوق من عسياتها وتذوق عن عسياته )م حلي ) زيل سن علي عن أديه عن جله (ر ضي الله عنهم ) ف الرجل يقول لامرأته اعتدى . قال: إن كان لم يدخل ا بانت . لأا لا عدة عليها » وإن كان قد دخل ما فهي واحدة علاك با الرجعة .
hadiths.text_english: Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them): What did you intend? If he said: "I intended one," it was one irrevocable divorce. And she (1) then observes the remainder of her waiting period from the first (husband) after the separation, then she begins a full waiting period from the second. End of Minhaaj bil-Mughni. (2) Imam Muhammad ibn al-Mutahhar (may Allah be pleased with him) said in al-Minhaaj, and from him, meaning from Imam Zayd ibn Ali (may Allah be pleased with him), that he said: Two men from Quraysh came to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and said: "Our father divorced our mother a hundred divorces." He (may Allah be pleased with him) said: "Your father disobeyed his Lord, so He did not make a way out for him. Your mother is irrevocably divorced from your father with three (divorces), and ninety-seven are a sin." End of Minhaaj. It is said: Regarding the allusions of divorce, "You are free!" End of Misbah. And in it is the wording: "You are irrevocably divorced from me," "You own yourself." And if he said: "I intended three," she was forbidden until she marries another husband. And she is not lawful for the first until she has intercourse (3) with the second and he tastes of her sweetness and she tastes of his sweetness. (4) Ali, from Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather (may Allah be pleased with them): Regarding a man who says to his wife: "Observe your waiting period." He said: If he had not consummated the marriage with her, she is irrevocably divorced, because there is no waiting period for her. And if he had consummated the marriage, then it is one (divorce) and he has the right to take her back.

hadiths.text_arabic: حدثني زبـك بن علي عن أبيه عن جاد عن علي رضي الله عنهم قال: ثلاث لا لعب فيهن: التكاح، والطلاق، والعتق.
hadiths.sanad: )0 حدثي ) زبك سن علي عن أديه عن جاده عن علي ) رضي الله عنهم )
hadiths.matn_ar: قال : ثلاث لا لعب فيهن : التكاح » والطلاق » والعتاق .
hadiths.text_english: It is narrated from Zayd ibn Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, on the authority of his father, on the authority of his grandfather, on the authority of 'Ali, may Allah be pleased with them. He said: There are three matters in which there is no play or jest: fornication (takhalluk), divorce (talaaq), and manumission ('itqa').

hadiths.text_arabic: حدثني زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي رضي الله عنهم قال: طلاق السكران جائر؟ من بابي ضرب وقتل قطعه وبت الرجل طلاق امرأته فهي مبتوتة، والضحدرت حتلاقيا وطتلقيا طلقة مق بو خلذكا بحة إذ قطعها عن الويجعة: وأبيت طلاقها بالألف لغة. قال الأزهرى: ويُستعمل الثلاثي والرباعي لازمين ومتعديين فيقال: بت طلاقها وابته، وطلق باتاً ومبتاً. قال ابن فارس: ويقال لما لا رجعة فيه: لا أفعله بتة، وبتت يمينه في الدحلف تبت بالكسر لا غير يتوتأ. صدقت ويرت فهي بتة. رواقة: ولعافت عيذ يقة ماحة: أي ينرةا. تويك شهانانه بوايقيا. بالطلاق جزم بها ومنه أيضاً وبتله بتلا من باب قتل قطعة واباته وطلقها طلقة بقة بتلة وتيتل إلى العبادة تفرغ لها وانقطع. قال في أمالي الإمام أحمد بن عيسى رضي الله عنه: ما لفظه: حدكنا محمك. قال حدثني أحمد بن عيسى عن حسين عن أبي خالد عن زيد بن علي رضي الله عنه أنه كان يقول في الحرام: نوقفه فتنقول ما تويت، فإن قال: نويت واحدة كانت واحدة بائنة وهي أملك لنفسها وليس له عليها رجعة؛ وهي رجل من الخطاب: ولا يخطبها في العدة أخذاقيوة لأنها تعتن عن مكة. وإن قال: قوعي كاذك كانت حرام هم تنكح زوجاً غيره، وإن قال: لم أنى شيئًا كانت واحدة يملك عليها الرجعة أي واقم. (حدني) زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن ده عن عل رز وق اللا عنهم. قال: قال رسول الله ﷺ: رُفِعَ القلم عن ثلاثة: الناكح حتى سرتي، والمجنون حتى دفيق، والصبي سحم دباغ.
hadiths.sanad: )0 حدثي ) زيك سن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي ) رضي الله عنهم 4

hadiths.text_english:
Here is the translation of the hadith text:

1. It was narrated from Zayd ibn Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali, may Allah be pleased with them: "Is divorce due to intoxication considered invalid?" He said: "From my viewpoint, it is like striking a blow and killing a piece of meat. If a man divorces his wife, she becomes a cut-off one (mubtua), and I do not consider her halal until he has given her the full amount of divorce (talaaq al-mughallaza)."

The Azhari said: "The tripling (talaaq thalath) and the repeated divorce (talaaq al-ri'aya) are both necessary and obligatory."

He said: "It is said: 'Divorced by one divorce, and divorced by two divorces.' And it is said: 'Divorced in two ways, and divorced in three ways.'"

Ibn Firas said: "And it is said: 'When there is no going back (in the divorce): I will not do it with a talaaq al-batna'."

He said: "If he takes an oath by his right hand in the divorce, she becomes halal with a kaffara (expiation) of the kaffara. And if he says: 'I have divorced her,' and then says: 'I have taken back my talaaq al-batna,' she is considered halal."

2. It was narrated from Imam Ahmad ibn Isa, may Allah be pleased with him, in his book "Amali": "He said: We were told by Husayn from Abu Khalid from Zayd ibn Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, that he used to say about the forbidden things (al-haram): 'I have vowed one vow, and it is a single vow.'"

He said: "If he says: 'I have vowed to abstain from something,' then it is considered a single vow. And if he says: 'I have vowed to do something,' then it is considered a single vow."

He said: "And if he says: 'I have vowed not to marry a woman who has been married before,' then it is considered a single vow, and she is forbidden to him. And if he says: 'I have vowed not to marry a woman who has not been married before,' then it is considered a single vow, and he has the right of return (rajaa') over her."

3. It was narrated from Ridwan ibn Ali, may Allah be pleased with them, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali, may Allah be pleased with him: "The Prophet said: 'The pen is lifted from three things: the sleeper who forgets, the madman, and the child.'"

hadiths.text_arabic: حدثي زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي (رضي الله عنهم) قال: إذا بلغ الغلام إثني عشرة سنة جرى عليه وله فيما بينه وبين الله تعالى، فإذا طاعت العانة وحجت عايه الحدود.
hadiths.sanad: ( حدثي ) زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي ( رضي الله عنهم )
hadiths.matn_ar: قال : إذا بلغ الغلام إثني عشرة سنة جرى عليه » وله فيما بينه وبين الله تعاللى ع فَإذا طاع.ت العانة وحجيث عايه الحدود .
hadiths.text_english: Zayd ibn Ali said: When a boy reaches the age of twelve, he is circumcised and has a share in what is between him and Allah, so if his foreskin is cut off and he is punished for any crime he commits.

hadiths.text_arabic: ( حدثي ) زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي ( رضي الله عنهم ) في الرجل يطلق امرأته تطليقة أو تطليقتين فيتزوج بها زوج غيره : ويدخل بها ثم تعود إلى الأول قال : تكون معه على ما بقي من الطلاق لا يهدم النكاح الثاني الواحدة والثنيتين ويهدم الثلاث. فمن طلق امرأته ثلاثا، نقول : روينا عن النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم وعن علي وعلي بن الحسين وزيد بن علي ومحمد بن علي الياقر ومحمد بن عار بن علي وجعقر بن محمد وعيبد الله وأبي الحسن ومحمد بن عيد الله وخيار آل رسول الله رضي الله أمرأته حتى تنكح زوجا غيره ولها السكنى والنفقة حتى تنقضي عدتها. قال الحسن بن يحيى اجمع آل الرسول صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم دخل بها الزوج، أي لم يدخل.
hadiths.sanad: ( حدثي ) زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي ( رضي الله عنهم ) في الرجل يطلق امرأته تطليقة » أو تطليقتين فيتزوج بها زوج غيره : ويدخل بها ثم تعود إلى الأول
hadiths.matn_ar: قال : تكون معه على ما بقي من الطلاق لا يهدم النكاح الثاني الواحدة والثنيتين » ويهدم الثلاث . ججغ طلق امرأته ثلاثا في كلمة نقول : روينا عن النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم ٠‏ وعن علي وعلي بن الحسين + وزيد بن علي ٠‏ ومحمد بين علي الياقر » ومحمد ين عر بن على + وجعقر بن محمد وعيبد الله أين الحسن » ومحمد بن عيد الله » وخيار آل رسول الله رضي الله امرأته حتى تنكح زوجا غيره + ولها السكنى ,. والنفقة » حتى تنقضي عدتها قال الحسن بن يحيى اجمع آل الرسول صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم دخل بها الزوج » أى لم يدخل 1ه , وكذاأ في حاشية أبن الوزير 5 ( جلو ) قال في آمالي الامام أحمد بن عيسى رضي الله عنه ما لفظه :
hadiths.text_english: Zayd ibn Ali reported from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) about a man who divorces his wife in one divorce or two. He then marries her to another man and has relations with her. She returns to the first husband and remains with him for what is left of the divorce period. The second marriage does not become invalid, whether it was one or two divorces. However, if he divorces her three times in one statement, we say: We have been informed by the Prophet (peace be upon him), Ali, Ali ibn al-Husayn, Zayd ibn Ali, Muhammad ibn Ali al-Yaqri, Muhammad ibn Uthman ibn Ali, Ja'far ibn Muhammad, and Abd Allah ibn Hasan, as well as other noble descendants of the Prophet (peace be upon him). If a woman's husband divorces her three times in one statement, her marriage to another man becomes invalid. Her maintenance and residence with the new husband remain valid until she has completed her waiting period.

hadiths.text_arabic: حدثنا محك بن رأشد عن نصر بن مزاحم عن أبي خالد الواسطي رضي الله عنه. عثة: عن رجحل. طلق امراته كلاكا'فى كلمة ؟ قاكن :: يانت منه لا تحل له حتى تنكح زوجا غيره ١ه ( خدئني ) زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي ( رضي الله عنهم) قال : قال رسول الله ﷺ: "لا طلاق ولا عناق إلا ما ملكت عقدته".
hadiths.sanad: حدثنا محك بن رأشد عن نصر بن مزاحم عن أبي خالد الواسطي رضي الله الحنادق رضي اللة.عثة: عن :رجحل .طلق امراته كلاكا'فى كلمة ؟ قاكن] :: يانت منه لا تحل له حتى تنكح زوجا غيره ١ه ٠‏ ( خدئني ) زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي ( رضي الله عنهم )
hadiths.matn_ar: قال : قال رسول الله ملع : ولا طلاق ولا عناق إلا ما ملكت عقدته» .
hadiths.text_english: We were informed by Muḥakk b. Raʾshid from Naṣr b. Mazāḥim from Abū Khālid al-Wāsīṭī, may Allah be pleased with him, from Ṣaḥl b. ʿAqīl: A man divorced his wife in one word. He said to her: "Divorced." The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: "Neither divorce nor repudiation is valid except for what he has taken hold of the bond."

hadiths.text_arabic: ( سألت ) زيداً بن علي ( رضي الله عنه ) عن رجل قال فلانة فهي طالق ؟ قال: أكرهه وليست بحرام : ( وسألته ) أني عن أبيه عن علي ( رضي الله عنهم ) أنه قال : ثلاث نحط أ من وعمدهن وهزضهن » وبحدهن سواء الطلاق : والعتاق والتكتاح : ( وسألته ) ( رضي الله عنه ) عن الطلاق بالفارسية والقرطية ؟ قال : : الطلاق بكل لسان . وسأله ) عن : الرجل يعلق في نفسه ولا يتكلم بلسانه ؟ قال : لا تطلق . ( وسألته ) ( رضي الله عنه ) عن : الرجل إن قال لامرأته أنت طالق إن شاء الله : أو قال لعبده : اتعوسصر إن شاع اش ؟ قال : إذ تلق لفراكة ول عق عمد ف قال : وسأله ( رضي اسيم ) عن قال لامراته ا طالق وطالق » وطالق قال : إن كان دشحل بها فثلاث وإن لم يدخل . إن قيل ؛ وما في هذا الخبر من دلالة على وقوع طلاق المكره » وهى اكت ل ا اي عليه لا ذية أبي الحسين رضي الله عنه أنه ما حلف يمين قط الا استكثنى قفيها فقال: ان شاء الله تعالى كان ذلك في رضى أو غضب وقال رضي الله عنه الاستثناء من كل شيء جائن يعنى بائن لان من طلق التي لم يدخل بها مرة بانت منه ا ها ام با قاد قال انك ظالق زنا .جني الاك تا عات دخل بها أم لم يدخل . ياب الخلع

hadiths.text_english: I asked Zayd ibn Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) about a man who said, "So-and-so is divorced." He said, "I dislike it, but it is not unlawful." And I asked him (may Allah be pleased with him) about the Prophet (peace be upon him) who narrated to me, from his father, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) that he said: "Three things, whether done seriously or in jest, are binding: divorce, emancipation, and marriage." And I asked him (may Allah be pleased with him) about divorce in Persian and Coptic. He said: "Divorce is valid in any language." And I asked him about a man who divorces in his heart but does not speak with his tongue. He said: "She is not divorced." And I asked him (may Allah be pleased with him) about a man who says to his wife, "You are divorced, if Allah wills," or says to his slave, "You are free, if Allah wills." He said: "She is not divorced, and he is not freed." And I asked him (may Allah be pleased with him) about a man who says to his wife, "You are divorced, and divorced, and divorced." He said: "If he has consummated the marriage with her, then it is three divorces. If he has not consummated the marriage with her, then it is one divorce." (1) If it is said: "What is the indication in this report for the validity of the divorce of one who is coerced?" And it is said that Abu al-Husayn (may Allah be pleased with him) never swore an oath except that he made an exception in it, saying, "If Allah wills," whether in pleasure or in anger. And he (may Allah be pleased with him) said: "An exception is permissible in everything." (2) Meaning, it is an irrevocable divorce, because whoever divorces a woman with whom he has not consummated the marriage once, she becomes irrevocably divorced from him. (3) This is the opinion of those who say that if he says to her, "You are divorced," it is one divorce, whether he has consummated the marriage with her or not. Chapter on Khul' (divorce by mutual consent).

hadiths.text_arabic: (حدثني) زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي -رضي الله عنهم- أن إذا قبل الرجل من امرأته فدبَّ فقد دالت منه دتطامقة.
hadiths.sanad: ( حدثي ) زيد بن على عن أبيه عن جده عن علي ( رضي الله عنهم ) إذا قبل الرجل من امرأته فدبة فقد دالت منه دتطامقة .
hadiths.text_english: It was narrated from Zayd ibn 'Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, that 'Ali (may Allah be pleased with him and them) said: "When a man accepts a gift from his wife, it is considered a dowry."

hadiths.text_english: Zayd ibn Ali reported from his father from his grandfather from Ali, may Allah be pleased with him: "The one who is afflicted by the cold (of winter) for three days has a right to take a maintenance allowance. If he divorces his wife during this time, the divorce is not valid until he has completed the waiting period."

hadiths.text_arabic: (حدثي) زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي (رضي الله عنهم) في: الرجل يطلق امرأته طلاقاً بائناً؟ قال: ليس له أن يتروج أختها حتى ينقضي أجلها. ونعم الرجل أن يكون له أربع نسوة فيطلق إحداهن طلاقاً بائناً. قال: ليس له أن زوج تجا مسة حتى تنقضي عادة المطألة منهن. والفرق بين

hadiths.text_english:
Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with them) said concerning a man who divorces his wife with an irrevocable divorce: He is not permitted to marry her sister until her waiting period has ended. And concerning a man who has four wives and divorces one of them with an irrevocable divorce: He is not permitted to marry a fifth wife until the waiting period of the divorced wife among them has ended.

The difference between "You are divorced," "and divorced," "and divorced," and his saying "You are divorced three times" is that his saying "You are divorced" to a woman with whom he has not consummated the marriage is a single irrevocable divorce. So his saying "and divorced, and divorced" is the pronouncement of divorce upon one whose marriage bond he does not possess due to her irrevocability from him. This is in contrast to his saying "You are divorced three times," for she is not divorced except by the combination of the words, and the intention here is considered. If the marriage has been consummated, she is divorced three times. If the marriage has not been consummated, then it is likewise.

hadiths.text_arabic: حدثي زيد بن على عن أبيه عن جده عن عي رضي الله عنه أن امرأة فقدت زوجها تزوجت زوجاً غيره ثم جاء أول علي رضي الله عنه: نكاح الأخير فاسد ولا المهر بما استحل من فرجها. وردها إلى الأول وقال: لا تقربها حبى تنقضي عدما من الأخير

hadiths.text_english: Zayd ibn 'Ali said, "My father said, 'My grandfather said, 'The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: If a woman loses her husband and marries another man, then the first husband comes to her, she has committed an invalid marriage and the dowry is not valid for what she has allowed from her private parts.' He returned her to the first one and said: 'Do not approach her until the term of the later one has ended.'"

hadiths.text_english: Zayd ibn Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, narrated from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali, may Allah be pleased with them, that he would give the impotent man a year's grace. If he was able to consummate the marriage, then good, otherwise, he would separate them.

hadiths.chapter_name_ar: باب الامة يتزوجها الرجل على انها حرة
hadiths.text_arabic: (حدثنا علي عن أبي عن جده عن علي، الله عنه - أو ما شابه ذلك) أن امرأة تزوجها رجل فأوتها أولاداً، وإن سيدها أعثر بها داابينة العادلة فقال: بأخذها سيدها وأولادها أحرار. وعلى أبيهم قيمتهم على قدر أسنائهم صغار فصغار وكبار فكبار. ويرجع في الذي غُفّ (أو ما يشابهه) فإن لم يغرّه أحد، رجع على الأمة: فإذا عتقت طامبها بذلك ولا شيع على سيدها هم إن كانت هي التي دلست عليه بأنها حرة وجب على سيدها تسليمها إلى أبي الأولاد بجنايتها؛ لأن تدليسها جناية والجذاية تتعلق برقبتها. فإن سلّمها سيدها بجنايتها فله قيمة أولادها، وإلا فما زاد على قيمتها أن أخثار إمساكها. (وهو من كلامه) قال في الجامع الكافي: مسألة عدة الرجل، قال محمد رضي الله عنه: يجب على الرجل العدة من أربعة أوجه؛ إذا طلق امرأته فلا يتزوج أختها حتى تنقضي عدة المطلقة، وإذا كانت له أربع نسوة فطلق أحدهن فلا يتزوج خامسة حتى تنقضي عدة المطلقة. وإن كانت له أربع نسوة فارتدت إحداهن عن الإسلام ولحقت بدار الكفر فلا يتزوج حتى تنقضي عدة.

hadiths.text_english:
(Narrated to me by Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali) may Allah be pleased with them, that a slave woman fled to Yemen. A man married her and she bore him children. Then her master found her and brought forth clear evidence. So he said: Her master takes her, and her children are free. And their father owes their value according to their ages, young for young, and old for old. And he may return to the one who deceived him about her freedom. If no one deceived him, he may return to the slave woman. When she is freed, he may demand it from her. And there is nothing upon her master. If she was the one who deceived him by claiming to be free, then her master must hand her over to the father of the children due to her transgression. Because her deception is a transgression, and the transgression is attached to her neck. If her master hands her over due to her transgression, then he gets the value of her children. Otherwise, he gets what exceeds her value if he chooses to keep her.

(In his hand) He said in Al-Jami' Al-Kafi: A matter of a man's waiting period. Muhammad, may Allah be pleased with him, said: A man must observe a waiting period in four situations: If he divorces his wife, he may not marry her sister until the divorced woman's waiting period ends. If he has four wives and divorces one of them, he may not marry a fifth until the divorced woman's waiting period ends. If he has four wives and one of them apostatizes from Islam and joins the land of disbelief, he may not marry until her waiting period ends.

hadiths.text_english: It has been narrated to me by Zakariyya ibn Ali from his father from his grandfather from Alah, may Allah be pleased with them. He said: "When a woman is given in marriage and she chooses her husband, there is no objection. And if she chooses herself, then one (husband) is sufficient for her. If he says to her: 'I have been commanded to divorce you,' then the divorce is carried out even if she does not speak. And if she rises from her bed before him, there is no blame on either of them."

hadiths.text_arabic: ( حدثي ) زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي ( رضي الله عنهم ) في الرجل يظاهر من امرأته فعليه الكفارة. قال الله تعالى: "عتق رقبة مؤمنة كانت أو كافرة" وقال في القتل: "ولا يقتل إلا رقبة مؤمنة". فإن لم يحد فصيام شهرين متتابعين، وإن لم يستطع فإطعام ستين مسكيناً عنه". ( عن: الرجل يظاهر من أمّه؟ فقال: لا شيء عليه). وسألته رضي الله عنه عن: المرأة تظاهر من زوجها؟ فقال: لا شيء عليها. وسأاته رضي الله عنه عن الرجل يظاهر من أربع مرات؟ قال: أربع كفارات. وقال أبي حنيفة وأصحابه له أن يتزوج والرابعة إذا كان لرجل امرأة ولها ولد من غيره فمات ولدها من غيره: فعليه أن يمسك من جماعها حتى يستبري ما في بطنها، لعل في بطنها ولد يرث أخاه المتوفي. ( بلفظه ). قال في أمالي أحمد بن عيسى رضي الله عنه بسنده إلى علي رضي الله عنه قال: إذا قذف امرأته وأقام على القذف وهي متكرر لولدها تلاعنا ما لم تكن بينة، فإن أنكر وأقامت البينة حلف وكانت أمراته، وإن أقر أنه كاذب جلد حدا وكانت امراته. و إن ظاهر من امرأته مراراً: فإن كان ذلك في مجلس واحد فكفارة واحدة، وإن كان ذلك في مجلسين فأكثر ففي كل مجلس كفارة. ( ياب الإيلاء)
