hadiths.sanad: ( حدثي ) زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي رضي الله عنهم
hadiths.matn_ar: قال : اللتان سسنة للرجال » تكرمة للنساء .
hadiths.text_english: Zayd ibn Ali reported from his father from his grandfather from 'Ali may Allah be pleased with him, saying: "The two salahs that are obligatory for men are a honor for women."

hadiths.text_arabic: (حدثي) زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي رضي الله عنه أنهم قال: من أكل على الريق إحدى وعشرين ل لم يضره ذلك اليوم، ومن أدام الغسل بالماء السعون لم يضره داع. hadiths.text_english:
Here is the translation of the hadith text:

It was narrated from Zayd ibn 'Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from 'Ali may Allah be pleased with him and them: "Whoever eats on an empty stomach for twenty-one days will not be harmed by it that day. And whoever performs ablution with cold water will not be harmed by it."

hadiths.text_arabic: حدثني زَيْدُ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عن عَنْ وَلَّةَ عن علي رضي الله عنه أنَّ رسولَ اللهِ ﷺ قال: «كان رسولُ اللهِ يأكلُ... ومن الأطعمةِ الـ...» ورأيتُ رسولَ اللهِ يَلْتَقِطُ الدِّياءَ، ورأيتُ رسولَ اللهِ ﷺ يأكلُ الطبَّ بالحَرْبَزِ.

hadiths.text_english: Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ali (may Allah be pleased with him) who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) would not eat anything from the hot, the moist, or from the cold foods, nor from the fresh vegetables. And I saw the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) picking up the gourd from the plate. And I saw the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) eating fresh dates with bread.

hadiths.text_arabic: زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن ... رضي الله عنهم قال : قال رسول الله ﷺ : « الوضوء قبل الطعام دركة، ودعاءه دركة » ولا يفتقر أهل بيت يتأدمون اللوازم. ... وأما قصة علي رضي الله عنه حين كان في الكوفة وهو يحارب معاوية، ففي صحن مسجدكم هذا عتبياً حمائل سيفه وحوله الناس، فأقرب الناس منه أصعداب رسول الله ﷺ لما لقظه: «العجوة من أجود التمر بالمدينة ونخلها يسمى لينة وقد جاء في الحديث العجوة من الجنة». ويُروى أيضاً أن النبي ﷺ قال: «الكماد من المن وماؤها شفاء للعين، والعجوة من الجنة وفيها شفاء من السقم، وفي القاموس العجاوة والعجاية...» وفي صفته صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم أنه كان أبيض اللون مشرب مرة أدعج العينين سبط الشعر دقيق العرنين وأسهل اللحدين ودقيق المسربة كث اللحية: كان شعره مشدّه إذا طال كأنه عنقه إدريق فضة له شعر من لؤمته إلى سرته، وكالقضيوب. والدعج أن تكون العين شديدة السواد مع سعة المقلة.

hadiths.text_english:
Here is the translation of the hadith text:

It was narrated to me by Zayd ibn Ali from his father from his grandfather from Ali, may Allah be pleased with him. He said: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, said: "The date palm before food is a dirham (a unit of currency), and the dirham is a dirham." And the people of the household do not become destitute, they are satisfied.

Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, was in Kufa, fighting against Mu'awiya. He had his sword slung over his shoulder, and people were saying: "This is Ali, may Allah be pleased with him." The closest person to him was the Messenger of Allah's companion, al-Musayyab ibn Najaba.

It has been narrated in a hadith that the date palm is from Jannah (Paradise). And it is narrated from Jabir ibn Abdullah that the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said: "The date palm is from the best of trees." And there is healing for the eye in its juice. And the date is from the Jannah, and there is healing from the sim (a type of disease) in it.

And the hadith also mentions that the date palm is called al-'ajwa', and its fruit is called al-'ajwah. And it is said that the date palm is like a tree with many branches, and its fruit is like the best of dates.

Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, was in Kufa, fighting against Mu'awiya. A companion of his came to him and said: "Tell us about the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him." Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, looked up and said: "I saw the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, as if I were looking at him now."

He then raised his head and said: "Yes, the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him, was a man with a reddish-brown complexion, curly hair, and a beard that was like a black cloud. His eyes were like two shining stars, and his hair was like silk. He had a mole on his cheek, and his nose was like a camel's hump."

Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, said: "His hair was thick and luscious, and it would fall across his forehead when he walked." And he described the Messenger of Allah's peace be upon him) as having a beard that was like a black cloud.

And Ali, may Allah be pleased with him, said: "I have never seen anyone with more beautiful hair than the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him. His hair was like silk, and it would fall across his forehead when he walked."
